answer: Each challenge is derived after enrollment from a domain-separated hash of the participant’s commitment and a future drand threshold-BLS pulse, unpredictable before quorum and publicly verifiable afterward. A swarm therefore cannot precompute answers or farm a reusable cache offline; it must answer each issued challenge, while commit–reveal binds attempts and exposes equivocation. Labels such as harbor, reef, and echo can separate challenge domains, but Sybil resistance still depends on enrollment controls.
